title: American College of Sports Medicine Position Stand. Resistance Training Prescription for Muscle Function, Hypertrophy, and Physical Performance in Healthy Adults: An Overview of Reviews
publisher: Currier and colleagues; American College of Sports Medicine
sourceVersion: doi:10.1249/MSS.0000000000003897; PMID:41843416; PMCID:PMC12965823; selected Eligibility, Power and Muscular Endurance sections
rightsReference: Source article states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Only brief original factual observations and linked attribution are retained; no source table, figure, paragraph or adapted reproduction of the work is published. No permission to adapt the full work or use it commercially is asserted.
limitations: Eligible healthy adults aged at least 18 with no defined disease, in resistance-training studies lasting at least six weeks; group results are not individual predictions or clinical/youth guidance.
Most included reviews concerned participants with minimal or no resistance-training experience; some included advanced trainees.
The overview searched reviews through October 2024. Only the identified eligibility and adaptation sections support this extraction.
No independent human, clinical or new GRADE appraisal; overlapping reviews, differing protocols and insufficient variable-specific evidence constrain interpretation.
